Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit Appointed New Chief of Indian Air Force

Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit has been appointed as the next Chief of the Indian Air Force. He will assume the position on October 31, 2026, and will serve until December 31, 2028. Air Marshal Dixit has over 3300 to 3500 hours of flying experience and has been described as a proponent of the indigenous Tejas fighter jet. He has also been noted for his experience in bringing Mirage aircraft from France and has received multiple medals.
